description: Header file defining the ReuseAllocatorBase class, a base class for custom memory allocators that manage memory outside of the allocated blocks, supporting fallback allocators and memory management features.

classes.name: ReuseAllocatorBase
classes.description: A base class for custom memory allocators that handle memory outside of the allocated blocks, with support for fallback allocators and memory management.

classes.name: MemoryBlock
classes.description: Represents a block of memory with address and size, supporting merging and fulfillment checks.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory of a given size, with optional alignment.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Marks a memory block as free for recycling.

methods.name: GetCapacity
methods.description: Returns the total capacity of the allocator.

methods.name: TryFree
methods.description: Attempts to free a memory block.

methods.name: IncreaseMaxCapacityIfNecessary
methods.description: Increases the maximum capacity if needed.
